newsitem.title: USA: HMN, Marshalltown Savings to merge.
newsitem.headline: HMN, Marshalltown Savings to merge.

text.p: HMN Financial Inc said Tuesday that it had entered a definitive pact to merge with Marshalltown Financial Corp in a cash deal valued at $25.9 million, or $17.51 per share.
HMN said the deal would be slightly dilutive to earnings for the first 12 months after closing and accretive to earnings thereafter.

The company said Tuesday that the acquisition gives it an opportunity to expand into Iowa. HMN, the thrift holding company for Home Federal Savings Bank, operates seven retail banking offices and one mortgage banking office in Minnesota. It has $553 million of assets.
Marshalltown Financial is the thrift holding company Marshalltown Savings Bank FSB and has assets of $127.1 million.
The deal awaits regulatory and shareholder approval, but HMN said it should be completed by the end of the year.
HMN Financial shares closed unchanged Tuesday at 23. Marshalltown Savings shares closed at 15-1/2, also unchanged.
